utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. Just send me the latest list and timing, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — I’ll send you the date, time, and repair list soon. You’ll spread the word once I do, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s still on for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll make sure everyone has the updated list and timing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Rosa — I’ll help keep everyone updated and point folks to the right place and time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Bo—just give me a shout if something comes up while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do—thanks, Ira. I’ll grab the details and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. If you hear of anyone who wants to volunteer, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Folks around here usually pitch in when there’s a good cause.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — could you share the date, time, and what repairs are needed? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Just tell me what you still need for the repair drive, and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — I’m just keeping track of the location details for the repair drive, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what and pass along any changes as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell — that helps a lot. I’ll keep it low-key and handle the practical bits from here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — I just need the date, time, and repair list once Eli locks it in so I can plan around it and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—has anything changed yet, or do you still need supplies?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We still need supplies, and I’m coordinating who’s bringing what at the shed. If you can help, I’ll point you to the next task.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Gus — keep it simple: you handle the practical bits, and I’ll spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll stay on the practical bits and bring the tools if anything changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Just the date, time, and final repair list for the drive—once Eli locks it in, I’ll pass it along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — I’ll send you the date, time, and final repair list as soon as Eli confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — Sunday at the community center works for me. Send the updated list when you have it, and I can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Leo — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll send the updated repair list as soon as I have it.
